Gorham Bike & Ski Waterville Wednesday Night Mountain Bike Ride

Waterville, ME · Mountain bike

No-drop

Gorham Bike & Ski Waterville Wednesday Night Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Waterville, ME. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Gorham Bike & Ski, Waterville. About 12–15 miles, moderate. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: moderate. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Gorham Bike & Ski Waterville Wednesday Night Mountain Bike Ride group ride

A no-drop trail ride from the Waterville shop, usually at Quarry Road or Inland Pine Ridge. Twelve to fifteen miles at a moderate pace; if the group splits, it waits. The shop also runs a Thursday 5 pm road ride from the same spot.
